scope: Bounded independent readiness/projection/admission review of two gateway runtime files and two test files. Not an exhaustive security scan.

source.snapshotMethod: Immutable HEAD git archive plus exact four stable source/test worktree overlays; later worktree documentation changes excluded.

verifiedBehavior: recentPoll validates finite safe integer server time and nonnegative age, with strict15000ms admission threshold; freshness is repeated after the final active-lease read before new job/active writes.
MCP listDevices projects one time after owner-device reads; dashboard projects one time after grants/jobs/audit awaits.
Poll updates store explicit0..4 offer or null legacy omission together with the poll timestamp; legacy default4 delivery and zero-slot cancellation/expiry/queuing remain.

Capacity projection requires valid bounded count and a timestamp matching the last observed poll; old rows or malformed/mismatched fields project null. The field is an historical offer, never current free capacity.
Only authorized matching unexpired valid bounded agentResult completion records a whitelisted timestamp plus success/error outcome. Existing result rejection/replay checks precede the observation.
Result completion does not refresh lastSeen or capacity. No payload, arguments, request IDs, credential values or arbitrary errors enter the projected observation.
Executor health remains unknown in every device state; UI calls status recent/overdue/no recent poll, displays dated offers/results, and explicitly disclaims roundtrip/readiness proof.
Explicit deviceId and unchanged grant/owner/capability checks retain routing scope; stale selection never falls back to another fresh device.

Existing occupancy counts, pending sessions, read-only permissions, public inventory registryAdmission exclusion and textContent rendering remain. Exact public field whitelist intentionally adds observations and whitelists its five keys.

independentAdditionalCases: MCP inventory time after final owner epoch read
Mismatched capacity and future accepted-result timestamps suppressed without leaking added sentinels
Failure before result persistence preserves prior observation and leaves delivered job
Failure of later observation write leaves a complete consumable result and conservative prior metadata; replay cannot add observation
Same-tick legacy omission clears previous positive offer while delivering four queued requests
executed.caseCountingNote: 118 repository cases, plus rerun of four original regressions (overlapping the ported cases), plus five independent boundary cases; not127 distinct product tests.

partialFailureQualification.resultPersistenceFailure: No new accepted-result observation when finish fails before result persistence.
partialFailureQualification.observationPersistenceFailure: Completion can persist while the later device metadata write fails. AgentResult returns500; the client can still consume the completed result once, prior observation remains, and replay cannot fabricate an update.
partialFailureQualification.classification: Conservative missing/stale metadata; does not claim all related writes are atomic.

limits: Review binds only the four frozen source/test files and the recorded immutable baseline. Root documentation/AI/roadmap edits were deliberately excluded from this snapshot. Final published commit/tree and any subsequent delta require binding.
No full local gate, hosted matrix, actual-main qualification, deployed Durable Object or real two-owner/two-computer test is claimed here.
Test behavior used owned in-memory registry and controlled local fixtures; production was not contacted.
Additive MCP output may require strict external JSON shape consumers to accept the documented observations field; legacy field meanings, protocol inputs and read-only scope remain.
This does not verify executor health, implement version/update telemetry, enable routing defaults or satisfy the entire #58/#62/#53 acceptance scope.
